direction.title: DIRECTIONAL ACCURACY
direction.population: Population: matched h60 direction labels · private data · approximately 88 effective observations.
direction.verdict: The highest accuracy. An uncertain edge.
direction.explanation: MODEL_V2 leads this matched population by 1.26 percentage points over the zero-change control. The day-block confidence interval for that difference crosses zero; a reliable advantage is not established.

vf.title: NET-RETURN MEAN ABSOLUTE ERROR
vf.population: Population: Victory Fusion evaluation rows · private data · separate from P3 validation.
vf.explanation: The constant −60 bps forecast has the lowest error in this population. Neither Victory Fusion candidate improves on that control. Prediction error alone does not measure trading profitability.

p3.title: NET-RETURN MEAN ABSOLUTE ERROR
p3.population: Population: P3 validation rows · private data · never pooled with Victory Fusion evaluation rows.
p3.explanation: The purged ridge challenger has higher validation error than the constant forecast. It remains in shadow evaluation. These rounded values are specific to P3’s validation population.
